<noinclude><pagequality level="4" user="BRPXQZME" />{{running header|{{smaller|{{asc|ODE 2.}}}}|{{asc|THE MAJOR ODES OF THE KINGDOM.}}|381}}{{rule}}</noinclude>capital.{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Both she and king {{tooltip|''K''î|Jì}}{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Were entirely virtuous.{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
(Then) {{tooltip|Thâi-''z''ăn|Tàirén}} became pregnant,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
And gave birth to our king {{tooltip|Wăn|Wén}}.

This king Wăn,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Watchfully and reverently,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
With entire intelligence served God,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
And so secured the great blessing.{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
His virtue was without deflection;{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
And in consequence he received (the allegiance of) the states from all quarters.

Heaven surveyed this lower world;{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
And its appointment lighted (on king Wăn).{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
In his early years,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
It made for him a mate<ref>Heaven is here represented as arranging for the fulfilment of its purposes beforehand.</ref>;—{{lb}}On
the north of the {{tooltip|Hsiâ|[sic] Ho (Hé)}},{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
On the banks of the {{tooltip|Wei|Wèi}}.{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
When king Wăn would marry,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
There was the lady in a large state<ref>The name of the state was [[w:zh:有莘氏|Hsin]], and it must have been near the [[wikt:洽|Hsiâ]] and the [[w:Wei River|Wei]], somewhere in the south-east of the present [[w:Shaanxi|Shen-hsî]].</ref>.

In a large state was the lady,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Like a fair denizen of heaven.{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
The ceremonies determined the auspiciousness (of the union)<ref>'The ceremonies' would be various; first of all, divination by means of the tortoise-shell.</ref>,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
And in person he met her on the Wei.{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Over it he made a bridge of boats;{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
The glory (of the occasion) was illustrious.

The favouring appointment was from Heaven,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Giving the throne to our king Wăn,{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
In the capital of ''K''âu.{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
The lady-successor was from {{tooltip|Hsin|Xīn}},{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Its eldest daughter, who came to marry him.{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
She was blessed to give birth to king {{tooltip|Wû|Wǔ}},{{page other|{{wsp|0.5em}}|{{br}}}}
Who was preserved, and helped, and received (also) the appoint-<noinclude><!--¶-->
